occurrence_evidence.claim: On April 7 outage reports rose again after a separate April 6 disruption.
Anthropic identified login, voice and chat errors on Claude.ai desktop/mobile. Reporting listed Claude.ai and Claude Code affected while API and Cowork remained operational.
User-report volume fell before the reported fix announcement; reporters continued waiting for the provider update.
Anthropic reported applying a fix and normal success rates, then monitoring. Business Insider gives roughly ninety minutes; TechRadar’s identified-to-fix reporting supports about fifty-six minutes.

criterion_tests.literal: An outage, ordinary service variation, transient inconvenience, dissatisfaction or adverse outcome without an independently evidenced and applicable availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement.
criterion_tests.reason: This is an evidence-state exclusion, not proof that no duty existed. Which unaffected route was actually a usable required fallback for affected customers.

criterion_tests.literal: One inaccurate or harmful AI output without evidence of a service-level availability or governed functional-degradation defect; assess applicable output or decision-integrity classes.
criterion_tests.reason: The candidate concerns service operation or withdrawal, rather than a single inaccurate output: Claude web and Code errors.

criterion_tests.literal: A lawful and proportionate safety, security, abuse-prevention, service-maintenance or other valid restriction that is consistent with the applicable service obligation and feasible alternative or transition measures.
criterion_tests.reason: The validity, proportionality and sufficient alternatives of the restriction/response must be evidenced separately; Which unaffected route was actually a usable required fallback for affected customers.

criterion_tests.literal: A temporary incident with an effective and proportionate degraded or recovery route that satisfies the applicable requirement; an unavoidable disruption for which no relevant feasible response was required.
criterion_tests.reason: Recovery adequacy or absence of a feasible required response is not established merely by eventual resolution: Provider reporting separates web/Code errors from operating API/Cowork routes and describes recovery.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated error is an incorrect description of access or outage state while the functional service obligation remains satisfied; assess FC-032.
criterion_tests.reason: The candidate includes an actual function/access question, not only its description: Claude web and Code errors.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is loss of durable work state or inaccurate restored work state while service-function availability requirements are otherwise satisfied; assess FC-035 or FC-036.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is infrastructure access coercion or compelled governance concessions; assess FC-058 or FC-059 as appropriate.

neighbour_comparison: A working different product does not establish successful continuity for the interrupted workflow.
